attributes.name: Stole of the Inheritor
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card to reduce damage dealt to you by 2, or by 4 if dealt by a bane that has the Demon trait.

Reveal this card and bury a blessing that has the Iomedae trait to allow a character at your location to shuffle 1d4+4 random cards from his discard pile into his deck.

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
attributes.traits: Light Armor, Clothing, Magic, Divine, Healing, Iomedae

corrections.corrected_text: On the armor Stole of the Inheritor, add the Clothing trait.
corrections.issue: Should Stole of the Inheritor have the Clothing trait?
